title: Englisch 6 Gymnasium, 2. Fremdsprache (ZAM Academy)
description: English as second foreign language at Bavarian Gymnasium grade 6: 43 lessons on greetings, numbers and time, family and home, articles, pronouns and quantities, simple present, present progressive, simple past, going to and modal verbs, questions and question tags, school, food, shopping, clothes and festivals in the UK, the British Isles, London, the USA and Canada, and listening, reading, writing, mediation and pronunciation strategies, with 129 recall cards. Listening, live talk and current events need extra practice.
